user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 200 lux 到 500 lux
期望 声音 应低于 60 dB
期望 温度 处于 22 ℃ 到 28 ℃
空气质量 应 高于 90 Score
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 200 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 500 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 60 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN motor_control(2) babai_curtain
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() > 28 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() < 22 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) > 28 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(Temperature) < 22 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF miaomiao_air_monitor.reading(air_quality) < 90 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_air_fresh
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_diffuser
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() hannto_printer
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() redmi_television
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_wifispeaker
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_diffuser
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_air_fresh
